about.description: FNGU is an exchange traded fund perpetual listed on BingX, tracking MicroSectors FANG+ 3X Leveraged ETNs due January 23, 2045, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
